summary: Senti Biosciences filed an 8-K furnishing first-quarter 2026 financial results and a press release on clinical data for SENTI-202. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC event is disclosed. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings update with an operational update, not a special situation.
